watch.summary: The creator reacts with extreme loud disbelief when a pro Valorant player hits an insane shot.

beats.what: Creator watches pro Valorant match footage with commentary.
The pro player hits a crazy flick shot through smoke and flash.
Creator screams 'HOW DOES HE DO THAT?!' in high-pitched shock.
Creator wipes his head in disbelief.

watch.author: creator
watch.why: The creator's sudden, explosive vocal reaction delivers a fun burst of hype to an impressive gameplay shot. It leans more on high-energy gamer reaction than a structured comedy bit.
